_readme: 'Find your seat' role tracks (SPEC 5.2). Each 'name' must match an entry in projects.json -> disciplines; the projects shown under a track are pulled automatically from projects tagged with that discipline. 'what_you_do' items are written ONLY from the scope of real projects and name the project they come from ('project' = project id). 'fits' is a SUGGESTED mapping of majors, copied from the inferred 'fits' of the projects in this track; it does not mean members of those majors have done this work. Officers: correct it to match who actually worked on these projects.

tracks.name: Data & Engineering
tracks.summary: Build the models, databases and dashboards a client's decisions run on.

what_you_do.text: Source data and assess whether a machine-learning approach is viable.
Refine and benchmark forecasting models, including a time-series model and an LSTM.
Configure a Google Cloud SQL database and connect it to Looker Studio.
Rebuild a test-score dashboard segmented by demographics, district and state.

tracks.name: Strategy & Research
tracks.summary: Research the landscape, benchmark what works and turn it into a plan.

what_you_do.text: Develop monetization and legal-compliance strategy for a machine-learning startup.
Benchmark best practices from organizations comparable to the client.
Recommend a marketing approach to strengthen campus presence and outreach.

tracks.name: Product & Design
tracks.summary: Scope the work and design the processes product teams run on.

what_you_do.text: Build a client-outreach process for a new product-design organization.
Map a timeline and process flow so the organization can grow and handle leadership turnover.
[TBD: officers to add design-focused work (for example user research or prototyping) if SCG teams have done it]

tracks.name: Operations & People
tracks.summary: Design roles, documentation and processes that last beyond one semester.

what_you_do.text: Set up a knowledge-management system so documentation survives leadership changes.
Plan how senior members stay engaged and how presentation quality improves.
Document operating procedures from recruitment through client acquisition.
